newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends stronger in a dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends stronger in a dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 43.2850/2950 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday amid a lack of buying of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
"The market was absolutely quiet. There were very few deals and most were done at wide ranges," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at 7.0 to 7.5 percent, down from Thursday's closing at 7.25-7.75 percent, dealers said.
Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
